982:                   target_side.effects[PBEffects::StickyWeb]
983:     next false if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 6 &&
984:                   (target_opposing_side.effects[PBEffects::StealthRock] ||
985:                   target_opposing_side.effects[PBEffects::Spikes] > 0 ||
